C-GRAPH-COVERAGE.Summary: Close the three-layer graph coverage defect: describe the undescribed surfaces in .ngrace/graph/main.xml, restore the reverse edge from code to modules via MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS, and add a lint check that GraphAnchors can own the plan's module-ownable write scope.
C-GRAPH-COVERAGE.Problem:
Recorded three times as deferred debt (A36.4 after Phase 5, A46.6 after Phase 7, A52.3 after Phase 8) and never scheduled. In that interval it stopped being a documentation gap and became a defect in shipped product. Stage-1 re-derivation at 170a0c5 confirmed three independent layers, plus one under-count (corr 140):
Layer 1 — coverage. GD-MAIN declares 12 modules / 11 Path files. Repository has 56 non-test files under src/. Undescribed surfaces: src/gates (4), src/review (6), src/verification (2), src/query (5) — 17 files. A36.4/A46.6/A52.3 named gates/review/verification but never query.
Layer 2 — linkage. bun run ngrace lint --path . reports Governed files: 0 and 11 warnings graph.module-without-linked-files — one per Path-bearing module. No production source file carries a MODULE_CONTRACT; the reverse edge has never existed in this repository. The 11 warnings are one linkage problem reported once per module, not 11 coverage problems. examples/polyglot carries contracts (Governed files: 3, 0 warnings), which is why validate:examples stayed green and the root defect stayed invisible.
Layer 3 — consistency. Nothing constrains a plan's DurableScope/GraphAnchors against its ObservedWriteScope. C-REVIEW-SURFACE anchors M-CLI, M-LINT-CORE, M-LINT-CATALOG, M-SKILLS while writing eight files under src/review/ that no anchor names. C-GATE-SURFACE and C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION have the same shape. Lint reports 0 errors on those plans (archive semantic checks are not re-run; even as active content they would not fire today's rules).
Product consequence (A46.4). ngrace context --task projects Modules from GraphAnchors; every module ends Linked Files — none. selectedBytes still counts that empty projection. The slice's central promise — here is the code you need to read — has never once been non-empty here.

Goals.Goal: Layer 1: .ngrace/graph/main.xml (and matching V-M-* entries) describe the four undescribed surfaces under src/gates, src/review, src/verification, and src/query, within the 50-anchor / 30 KB document budgets.

Layer 2: every graph module that declares Path has at least one governed file with LINKS: M-* for that module. Root lint retires all graph.module-without-linked-files warnings by making the reverse edge true, not by deleting Path fields.
Layer 2 honesty: ROLE and MAP_MODE on every newly governed file are true of the file. ROLE: CONFIG / MAP_MODE: NONE is forbidden as an escape from MODULE_MAP on runtime code.

Layer 3: lint gains a check that active plans' GraphAnchors can own every module-ownable ObservedWriteScope path (non-test files under src/). The check is red on real C-REVIEW-SURFACE plan content when evaluated as an active plan (D16 / A46.4 witness).
context --task for a plan whose anchors name linked modules prints non-empty Linked Files for those modules, and the listed paths are real governed files.

Constraints.Constraint: Stage 1 is spec-only. No production code, graph edits, markup, or plan.xml until this draft is reviewed and the open decisions below are ratified.
Own bundle, own PR. Do not fold in C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS work (packed modules, scope-audit diff input, archive plan resolve). Do not touch RM-AGENT-RELIABILITY phase board rows.
D14: the layer-3 consistency check belongs on lint (static artifact check). It must not emit gate.* or review.* codes. verification remains a read-only query surface.
Do not retire graph.module-without-linked-files by removing Path. Path stays; linkage becomes true.
Archive immutability (CLAUDE.md / invariant): never edit files under .ngrace/changes/archive/. Historical plans are not rewritten to pass new rules.
Anchor budget: DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_ANCHOR_LIMIT 50 and DEFAULT_DOCUMENT_BYTE_LIMIT 30 KB (src/lint/types.ts). Modules are units of meaning, not files. Prefer one module per surface over module-per-file.

Roles must be true. Default inference (*.test.ts → TEST / LOCALS; else RUNTIME / EXPORTS) and export-parity exactness (this repo has zero production export *) apply. Entry scripts with zero exports use ROLE: SCRIPT / MAP_MODE: LOCALS when that is the honest role — never CONFIG to skip the map.

Surgical diffs. No new runtime dependencies. Skill mirrors stay byte-identical if skill text changes. Existing valid .ngrace trees remain loadable (invariant 5) — new check is additive and scoped to active plans.
Standing rule 11 (A46.3): every Linked Files line and every new lint message must read true aloud given the inputs the run actually had.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Governing every file under src/ in this bundle (lint/adapters, artifact helpers, CLI satellites not named by Path). Backfill of already-partial modules is a separate, optional follow-on unless required to keep layer-3 green for active work.
Rewriting archived C-REVIEW-SURFACE / C-GATE-SURFACE / C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION plans to pass the new layer-3 rule. They are the historical positive controls, not merge blockers.
C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS (A48.5 packed modules, corr 138 scope-audit input, corr 139 archive plan resolve).
Promoting graph.module-without-linked-files from warning to error in this bundle (may be reconsidered after linkage exists and is stable).
Changing selection (Phase 8) algorithm beyond the data it already projects. Once Linked Files is non-empty, context --task improves without selection code changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER1-MODULES-PRESENT: .ngrace/graph/main.xml declares modules for the four undescribed surfaces (gates, review, verification, query) with Path values pointing at real production files under those trees, and matching V-M-* entries exist under verification. Discriminating negatives: after the change, find src/{gates,review,verification,query} -name '*.ts' ! -name '*.test.ts' is non-empty and every such directory is named by at least one module Path prefix; removing any of the four modules reintroduces an undescribed surface under doctor/coverage or context projection for plans that anchor it.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER2-REVERSE-EDGE: bun run ngrace lint --path . reports zero graph.module-without-linked-files warnings. Governed files > 0. Every module that declares Path has ≥1 governed file whose MODULE_CONTRACT LINKS that module. Discriminating negatives: deleting LINKS from the Path file of M-CLI reintroduces graph.module-without-linked-files for M-CLI; a module with Path and no linked file is never silent.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER2-HONEST-ROLES: No newly governed production file uses ROLE: CONFIG (or MAP_MODE: NONE) unless the file is genuinely configuration. MODULE_MAP parity is exact for .ts (exportConfidence exact; zero production export *). Discriminating negative: labelling src/review/core.ts as CONFIG to skip MODULE_MAP fails review / is forbidden by the implementation checklist and by a test or lint policy that rejects CONFIG on non-config paths if such a guard is added; at minimum the PR description and map content show true RUNTIME/TYPES/SCRIPT roles.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER3-LINT-CHECK: lint emits a new change.* (or scope.*) code when an active plan's ObservedWriteScope lists a module-ownable path (non-test file under src/) that no GraphAnchors module owns. Ownership = Path exact match, or governed LINKS to an anchored module, or directory prefix of a nested Path (src/<dir>/... owns src/<dir>/**; Path files directly under src/ own only themselves). Discriminating negatives: (1) active plan whose content is C-REVIEW-SURFACE's GraphAnchors + OWS (real archive plan body, loaded as active in a temp project) produces the code; (2) the same plan with M-REVIEW (or equivalent) added to GraphAnchors and review files linked is silent for those paths; (3) README.md / package.json / docs/** / skills/** in OWS never alone produce the code.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LAYER3-ARCHIVE-POLICY: Archived plans are not rewritten and are not required to pass the new layer-3 rule. Root lint over this repository does not fail solely because archive/C-REVIEW-SURFACE (et al.) would fail if re-checked. Discriminating negative: adding the new code without an active/archive split re-fails the whole archive set and blocks every clean tree — that outcome is out of scope and must not ship.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CONTEXT-LINKED-FILES: After layers 1–2 land, bun run ngrace context --task T-001 --change <active plan that anchors a linked module> prints Linked Files with at least one real path for that module (not "- none"). Discriminating negative: a module with Path and LINKS still rendering "Linked Files — none" is a product regression of this bundle.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BUDGETS-HOLD: GD-MAIN and VD-MAIN stay under 50 anchors and 30 KB after new modules and V-M-* entries. Discriminating negative: graph.document-too-large or the anchor-limit warning fires on root as a result of this bundle's graph edits.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-NO-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS-SCOPE: This bundle does not implement C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS items (package.json files allowlist, validate:packed in CI, review --base/--changed-files, archive plan resolve for review). Discriminating negative: a diff that touches those concerns is out of this change's ObservedWriteScope once planned.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Root lint: 0 errors; 0 graph.module-without-linked-files; Governed files > 0; new layer-3 code silent on clean active tree and red on C-REVIEW-SURFACE plan body as active fixture. bun run validate:ci green. context --task shows non-empty Linked Files for linked modules. Unit + integration tests for the new issue code both directions (A7.2). D14: runLint never emits gate.* or review.*.

Assumptions.Assumption: OPEN DECISION A — coverage rule (recommendation: Path + co-located surface). Govern (1) every existing Path-named file (11), and (2) every non-test production file under src/gates, src/review, src/verification, and src/query once those modules exist. Do not require all 56 src/ files in this bundle. Standing future obligation: a PR that adds a graph module with Path under src/<dir>/ must govern Path and all non-test co-located siblings in the same PR; a PR that adds src/<new-surface>/ production code must add a module. Cost: ~11 + ~17 contracts and MODULE_MAPs (~180 exports on Path files alone; surface dirs add more). Cheaper "Path-only" (11 files) retires warnings but leaves multi-file surfaces half-linked; full-src (56 files / ~501 exports) completes the reverse edge today and rots unless a directory-ungoverned check is added — prefer the middle rule that matches how context --task and layer 3 ownership work.

OPEN DECISION B — module granularity (recommendation: four surface modules). Add M-GATES (Path src/gates/core.ts), M-REVIEW (Path src/review/core.ts), M-VERIFICATION-LOCALIZE or M-LOCALIZE (Path src/verification/localize.ts; also link check-references.ts if co-located rule applies), M-QUERY (Path src/query/core.ts). One module per D14/query/verification surface, not per file. Anchor math: 12+4=16 ≪ 50; graph ~2.6 KB today, stays well under 30 KB; four V-M-* siblings. context --task then projects one module card per surface with Linked Files listing the co-located set — readable and true. Finer splits (catalog/command as separate modules) burn anchors without improving the slice; a single M-PROCESS for gates+review would lie about ownership for layer 3.

OPEN DECISION C — layer-3 rule shape and severity (recommendation: error on active plans; ownable-path cover, not full OWS cover). Assert: every ObservedWriteScope File that is a non-test path under src/ must be owned by ≥1 GraphAnchors module (ownership as in AC-LAYER3-LINT-CHECK). Paths outside src/, test files, skills, docs, package.json, .ngrace/** are not module-ownable and never alone trip the rule — a naive "cover all OWS" rule is unsatisfiable and forbidden. Severity: error (must be able to block approve / fail CI when an active plan is wrong). Warning-only would re-create the skippable-11 pattern this bundle exists to end. Optional non-goal: warn when a GraphAnchor owns zero ownable OWS paths (noisy for M-SKILLS).

OPEN DECISION D — archived bundles (recommendation: absence with reason; do not require pass). Archived plans stay immutable and are not semantically re-linted for the new rule (same split already used for assertion evaluation: active semantic, archive syntax-only). At least C-REVIEW-SURFACE, C-GATE-SURFACE, and C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION would fail the rule if re-checked; that is historical record, not a green bar. D16 witness uses the real C-REVIEW-SURFACE plan body copied into a temp active bundle in tests — not an edit to archive/. No silent "archive clean" claim for the new code.
Correction 140 (stage-1 re-derivation): A36.4 / A46.6 / A52.3 under-counted the debt by omitting src/query (5 non-test files). Query is in scope for layer 1 of this bundle.

Entry-point files with zero exports (src/grace.ts today) cannot satisfy MAP_MODE: EXPORTS under exact parity: validateMapShape requires a non-empty MODULE_MAP, and any listed symbol is "extra" when language.exports is empty. Honest role for such files is SCRIPT / LOCALS (or another true non-EXPORTS role), not CONFIG.
